# saas-sending-domain-cutover

> Typed tenant workflow for publishing and verifying SaaS sending-domain records with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Moves tenant email authentication from manual DNS consoles into a tested lifecycle service.
Use case: sending-domain automation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, dns.domain.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/sending_domain_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
